name: opus-503d81b1-blind24
instr:
# A speech and audio codec library with 24 silent regressions and no test suite

The repository has received 24 separate undocumented edits.

A library that turns sound into compact bundles and turns those bundles back into sound is
now getting both directions wrong in a lot of places. Nothing about the format on the wire
changed and nothing about the calling programs changed. Material that used to survive a
round trip comes back damaged, and in several places a call that used to succeed is now
refused outright.

Putting ordinary audio in and listening to what comes back. At default settings the result
is hiss or near-silence instead of what went in, as though the loudness summary written at
the head of every bundle covered no part of the spectrum. At the smallest sizes, where
almost no room is left for that summary, the fallback that squeezes it into whatever space
remains is gone, and those bundles come back as garbage or are rejected as damaged. Tonal
music drifts in loudness from one part of the spectrum to the next, the discrepancy growing
with every step up the coded loudness scale. Material taken in from any source yields
loudness summaries that are wrong, and a long run of it ends in a corruption failure.
Two-channel material at middling budgets comes back with its top frequencies missing and a
quality loss the budget it was given does not justify. Whole numbers drawn from a bounded
